name: Active Patients in Care
description: This report provides patients that are Active in Care in a facility in a particular period of time

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 AND e.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM person p WHERE p.voided = 0 AND p.death_date IS NOT NULL AND p.death_date <= :endDate) AND e.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT e2.patient_id FROM encounter e2 WHERE e2.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e2.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND e2.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e3 WHERE e3.patient_id = e2.patient_id AND e3.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e3.encounter_datetime > e2.encounter_datetime AND e3.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e3.voided = 0))
